hero.title: Livestock as an investable asset — tracked head by head
hero.subtitle: MOL connects investors with vetted fattening farms in Tajikistan and the wider region. You fund a specific herd, it is assigned to you by contract, and the proceeds of the sale are shared under a mudarabah agreement.
hero.note: Returns are not guaranteed. The risks and fees are spelled out below.

programs.headline: Three programs
programs.title: Pick the herd that fits your horizon
programs.description: The first two programs are fattening: you own the animals while they grow. The third is a short meat trading cycle — buy a finished animal, slaughter, sell.

calc.headline: Simulator
calc.title: Model your own scenario
calc.description: Change the program, the herd size and the horizon — the model recalculates cycles, fees and the resulting portfolio value.
calc.reinvestOn: Each cycle's profit buys more animals — the portfolio compounds.
calc.reinvestOff: Profit is paid out after every settlement and the principal stays flat.

chart.title: Portfolio growth by cycle
chart.tableCaption: Portfolio value at the end of each cycle

calc.disclaimer: The model uses average fattening margins, meat trading spreads and provisional program parameters. It is a simulation, not an offer or a promise of return: the actual outcome depends on meat prices, mortality, exchange rates and sale timing.

lifecycle.headline: Lifecycle
lifecycle.title: What happens to your money, step by step
lifecycle.description: Five stages from application to settlement. At each one the investor gets a document or a report confirming the state of the asset.

s1.title: Application & contract
s1.text: You choose a program and a size, pass identity checks and sign a mudarabah contract with a fixed profit share.

s2.title: Purchase & tagging
s2.text: The farm buys the herd against your contract. Every animal gets an ear tag, a veterinary passport and a record in your dashboard.

s3.title: Fattening & monitoring
s3.text: Feeding and veterinary care are run by the partner farm. You receive a monthly report: weight gain, herd condition, photos and headcount data.

s4.title: Halal sale
s4.text: The herd is sold through a certified abattoir or by live weight to a wholesale buyer. Price and weight are recorded in an act filed to your dashboard.

s5.title: Settlement & decision
s5.text: Profit is split 60/40 in your favour and the principal returns. You withdraw or start the next cycle in one click.

transparency.headline: Oversight
transparency.title: How you know the asset is really there
transparency.description: Livestock investing lives or dies by record keeping. Ours is built so that every claim can be checked against a document.

sharia.headline: Islamic finance structure
sharia.title: Why this is mudarabah, not a loan
sharia.description: The investor provides capital, the farm provides labour and expertise. Profit is shared in a pre-agreed ratio and market losses fall on the capital. There is no fixed interest rate — that is the point.

mudaraba.title: Mudarabah contract
mudaraba.text: The 60/40 profit split is fixed in the contract before the cycle starts, rather than accruing as a percentage on the amount invested.

riba.title: No riba, no guaranteed yield
riba.text: We do not promise a rate. If a cycle loses money, the investor shares that outcome — otherwise it would be an interest-bearing loan.

asset.title: A real asset
asset.text: Behind every contract stands a living animal with a tag number, not a debt instrument or a derivative.

halal.title: Halal supply chain
halal.text: Feed, husbandry and slaughter follow the rules; sales go through certified facilities.

board.title: Shari'a supervision
board.text: Contracts and processes are reviewed by an appointed Shari'a advisor and the opinion is published.

sharia.note: The Shari'a board opinion will be published before funds are accepted.

risks.headline: Risks, stated plainly
risks.title: What can go wrong
risks.description: This is an investment in a living asset, not a deposit. These are the risks we refuse to bury in a footnote.

market.title: Meat prices
market.text: Seasonal swings and imports can cut a cycle's revenue, in a bad case to a loss.

bio.title: Mortality & disease
bio.text: Insurance does not cover every case; the deductible and exclusions are in the contract.

liquidity.title: Liquidity
liquidity.text: You exit at a settlement, not on any given day. Leaving mid-cycle requires someone to buy out your share.

fx.title: Currency risk
fx.text: Revenue is earned in local currency; converting to dollars can change the outcome.

ops.title: Operational risk
ops.text: Fattening quality depends on the partner farm. We vet partners but cannot rule out mistakes.

q1.a: The herd is assigned to the investor by contract, listing the tag numbers. The farm acts as manager (mudarib) and cannot dispose of the animals outside the contract terms.

q2.a: The case is recorded in an act and covered by the insurance policy. Any uncovered part reduces the cycle's result — that is the market risk the capital carries.

q3.a: Direct cycle costs are deducted from sale revenue and the remainder is split 60/40 in the investor's favour. The platform fee is fixed per head per cycle and does not scale with profit.

q4.q: When can I take my money out?
q4.a: At the settlement after the cycle closes — 6 to 9 months depending on the program. There is no exit penalty, but you cannot leave mid-cycle.

q5.a: It is set by the program lot: one head of cattle, or the minimum sheep lot. The calculator above shows the exact amounts.

q6.a: One: a fixed charge per head per cycle, included in the entry amount. No hidden deposit, withdrawal or management fees.

q7.q: How is this different from lending to a farmer?
q7.a: There is no fixed interest and there is an identifiable asset. You participate in the outcome rather than earning a rate — otherwise the contract would not be Shari'a-compliant.

q8.a: In the dashboard: tag number, monthly weight gain, photos and cycle documents. On request, a visit to the partner site.

cta.title: Want to run the numbers together?
cta.description: Leave a request and we will come back with a calculation for the chosen program, a draft contract and the next cycle start dates.
cta.note: We reply within one business day. A request commits you to nothing.

footer.about: Investing in live livestock with transparent record keeping and profit shared under a mudarabah agreement.
footer.disclaimer: The content of this site is informational and is neither a public offer nor individual investment advice. Livestock investing carries the risk of partial or total loss of the invested capital.
